development_failures: None of the new tests failed during development.

Design review found that the generic TikTok create receipt rule derives the ID key from the path segment after /v1.3/ (dmp for this route, so dmp_id), which would mark every successful creation as failed; the family checks saved_audience_id instead.
Design review found that verification reads are built without the request body, so the read-back projection covers every present field and the comparison keeps only the fields that were sent.
A first wiring command failed to parse in the shell and applied nothing; the same edits were applied from a script file and the build confirmed them.
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
Targeting IDs (locations, interests, carriers, device models, action categories) are checked for format only; TikTok validates them against its tool endpoints.
Minimum OS versions are checked for format only, because the enumeration points to /tool/os_version/ for the current list.
The 400-per-advertiser limit is enforced by TikTok; the list read does not page.
Referenced audiences must be owned by the advertiser; shared audiences are refused even where TikTok would accept them.
No GitHub CLI here and CAMCP is private: CI for the pushed commits was not read from this checkout.
No local Docker; container build/smoke evidence comes from GitHub Actions on the pushed commit.
